newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks rose in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage rose 2.97 million barrels in the week ended April 11 to 311.41 million barrels from a revised 308.44 million barrels previously reported as 309.95 million in the prior week, American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) rose 2.85 million barrels in the week to 248.66 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 2.59 million barrels to 100.97 million barrels from 98.39 million the prior week.
API said PADD 1 distillate stocks rose 710,000 barrels to 31.16 million barrels.
Gasoline production fell 267,000 barrels in the week to 7.41 million bpd from 7.67 million in the prior week.
Gasoline stocks rose 3.63 million barrels in the week to 199.62 million barrels from 195.99 million barrels.
Percent of stocks capacity fell to 93.6 percent from 94.3 percent.
Reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) rose 162,000 barrels to 35.11 million barrels from 34.95 million barrels the previous week.
API said crude runs to processing units fell to 14.21 million barrels from 14.34 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 40.47 million barrels from 39.75 million in the previous week.
Crude oil imports fell to 7.82 million barrels per day from 8.33 million.
